eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Pima, AZ; at 6:16 PM on AUG 13, 2020 Effective until 4:16 AM AUG 14, 2020. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Tucson Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Tucson Police Department is looking for a white male; David Freeland, 6 foot 1 inches, 160 pounds, gray hair, blue eyes, with a full gray beard, last seen in the area of 4 5 0 N. Wilmot Road, in the city of Tucson. Freeland was last seen driving a 2003 Gray Chevrolet Avalanche, Arizona license plate number P A G C E O. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
